china_race_dynamics.text:
We have a new arms race and it’s called AI. 

I sat down with KTVB’s Justin Corr to discuss immigration, health care, farming, and more.

To watch our full conversation, click here https://t.co/FX7ojwu6JB https://t.co/1sZAOuKIBq

deepseek.reason: The statement mentions an AI arms race but does not mention China or competition with China.
deepseek.confidence_reason: The China-specific target is absent; the arms-race phrase is generic.

china_race_dynamics.text: In the face of Chinese progress in emerging technologies, I am concerned about the U.S.'s ability to maintain its leadership position—if, in fact, we still have one, and I would like to get your opinion on that—in the AI race, especially if we were to follow the European approach, which I don't see us doing, or allow a patchwork of AI rules to develop across the various States.
china_race_dynamics.context: House hearing on AI regulation and U.S. leadership where Representative Fulcher questions a witness about strategic competition with China in AI.

deepseek.reason: The speaker frames Chinese progress as a threat to U.S. leadership in the AI race, endorsing competition as a priority.
deepseek.confidence_reason: He explicitly references Chinese progress and the AI race, though he does not explicitly call for a specific policy.
